'''Mariya Ryemyen''' ({{langx|uk|Марія Рємєнь}}; born 2 August 1987, [[Makiivka]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/ri/mariya-riemien-1.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418001226/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/ri/mariya-riemien-1.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=2020-04-18|title=Mariya Riemien Bio, Stats, and Results|website=Olympics at Sports-Reference.com|language=en|access-date=2017-04-11}}</ref>) is a [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Sprint (running)|sprint athlete]] who specializes in the [[100 metres]]. Ryemyen was part (with [[Nataliya Pohrebnyak]], [[Olesya Povh]] and [[Yelizaveta Bryzhina]]) of the Ukrainian women's 4 × 100 m that won gold during the [[2010 European Athletics Championships#Women.27s results|2010 European Athletics]] with 42.29 – the fastest time in the world that year.<ref>[https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/athletics/8875102.stm Chris Tomlinson secures European long jump bronze], [[BBC]] (August 1, 2010)</ref>

==Career==
She finished seventh at the [[2009 European Athletics U23 Championships|2009 European U23 Championships]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.sportresult.com/sports/la/framework/eaa2.asp?event_id=10000300000007&ctype_id=8&module=competition&show=RL&lang=en&#round_v31010040|title=Results 100m Women|date=17 July 2009|publisher=[[European Athletics]]|access-date=18 March 2010}}{{Dead link|date=September 2024 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> She also competed at the [[2010 IAAF World Indoor Championships – Women's 60 metres|2010 World Indoor Championships]] without reaching the final.<ref name=bio>{{World Athletics}}</ref>

In the [[4 × 100 metres relay]] she competed at the [[2009 World Championships in Athletics – Women's 4 × 100 metres relay|2009 World Championships]] without reaching the final.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.todor66.com/athletics/world/2009/Women_4x100m_Relay.html|title=Women 4x100m Relay Athletics World Championship 2009 Berlin (GER)|publisher=Todor Krastev|access-date=18 March 2010}}</ref> At the 2009 European U23 Championships the Ukrainian team failed to finish the race.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.sportresult.com/sports/la/framework/eaa2.asp?event_id=10000300000007&ctype_id=67&module=competition&show=RL&lang=en&#round_v31340040|title=Results 4x100m Relay Women|date=19 July 2009|publisher=[[European Athletics]]|access-date=18 March 2010}}{{Dead link|date=September 2024 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

Her personal best times are 7.15 seconds in the [[60 metres]] (indoor), achieved in March 2011 in [[Paris]]; and 11.27 seconds in the 100 metres, achieved in June 2011 in [[Montreuil-sous-Bois]].<ref name=bio/>

In 2011, she competed for [[Fenerbahçe Athletics]] in [[Turkey]].<ref>{{cite news |url=http://www.milliyet.com.tr/Spor/HaberDetay.aspx?aType=HaberDetay&ArticleID=1380491&Date=20.07.2012&Kategori=spor&b=Yildiz%20savaslari |newspaper=[[Milliyet]] |title=Yıldız savaşları |date=2011-04-21 |language=tr |access-date=2012-08-06 }}</ref> At the 2012 Olympics Maria represented the [[Central Sports Club of the Armed Forces of Ukraine|Armed Forces of Ukraine]] and the sports club "Ukraina". At the [[2012 Olympic Games]] in [[London]] she and her teammates [[Olesya Povh]], [[Hrystyna Stuy]] and [[Yelizaveta Bryzghina]] took the bronze medals in the [[Athletics at the 2012 Summer Olympics – Women's 4 × 100 metres relay|4 × 100 metres relay]] by setting a new [[Ukrainian records in athletics|national record]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.iaaf.org/Mini/OLY12/Results/ResultsByDate.aspx?racedate=08-10-2012/sex=W/discCode=4X1/combCode=hash/roundCode=f/results.html#detW_4X1_hash_f |title=International Association of Athletics Federations |publisher=iaaf.org |access-date=2012-08-12}}</ref><ref>[https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/olympics/18916209 USA smash world 4x100m relay record to win Olympic gold], [[BBC Sport]] (10 August 2012)</ref>

She served a two-year doping ban for the use of a prohibited substance, [[methandienone]]. The ban lasted from 10 January 2014 to 2 March 2016.<ref>[http://www.iaaf.org/download/download?filename=9dddbecd-633e-4aab-83ae-9b3ffa632050.pdf&urlslug=List%20of%20athletes%20currently%20serving%20a%20period%20of%20ineligibility%20as%20a%20result%20of%20an%20Anti-Doping%20Rule%20Violation%20under%20IAAF%20Rules IAAF list of athletes suspended for doping]</ref>
